Name: Grass Farm (CP)
Author: KukuOwl
Description:
[i]A small grassy farm map. [/i]


[color=#f4f4f4][u]Needed[/u] [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b]:[/color]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]﻿ContentPatcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[/list]

[size=3][b]FEATURES:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]Small and grassy farm.[/size]
[*][size=2]You can dig in the grass.[/size]
[*][size=2]Foraging all over the map.[/size]
[*][size=2]Blue grass does not naturally grow on this farm, but a small amount was added at the start of the game.[/size]
[*][size=2]The grass doesn't disappear in the winter.
[/size]
[/list]

[size=3][b]HOW TO INSTALL:[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=2]Download the mod.[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip.[/size]
[*][size=2]Folder [b][color=#c27ba0][CP] Grass Farm[/color][/b] copy to[color=#c27ba0] Stardew Valley/Mods[/color] folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game.[/size]
[*][size=2]Make a new game and select [b]Forest Farm[/b].[/size]

[/list]
[color=#f4f4f4]This Map replaces the [b][i]Forest Farm[/i][/b].


[size=3][b]Recommended mods (Make your farm prettier):[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿[/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]﻿[/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12078]Lumisteria- Alternative Textures - Grass[/url]﻿[/color]
[/list][/color]

[b][color=#ff00ff][size=3]This is a beta version of the map. Please report all bugs.[/size][/color][/b]
